articles.title: Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand: How PM Modi's New Arc Of Trust Is Reshaping The Indo-Pacific
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's six-day tour of Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand is far more than a diplomatic visit. It is India's biggest strategic push across the Indo-Pacific in years. From BrahMos missile exports and critical minerals in Indonesia to uranium cooperation and Quad ties with Australia, and a renewed Pacific outreach through New Zealand, India is stitching together what can be called an "Arc of Trust." As the United States recalibrates its regional priorities and China expands its strategic footprint, New Delhi is presenting itself as a trusted, reliable and independent partner. Is India becoming the Indo-Pacific's third pillar? Can Modi's trust-based diplomacy reshape the regional balance of power? Watch this detailed analysis.
